fields.title: 3. Probability and Value — No Change
fields.md:
- None of the probability adjustment rules R1–R6 was met by this event (13F unposted · the bond is not a rule subject, source: state.probability_adjustment_rules). Scenarios 25/50/25 maintained.
- Assumed value band $265.0–$684.5 · probability-weighted $469.6 · base $464.4 — same as the first round's values (calculation and sources in the value judgment section of the [2026-11 report](2026-11.md)).
- Price update (close): Class B $592.94 (2026-11-13, [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/brk.b/history/)) — 27.7% above the base present value (calculated 592.94 ÷ 464.4 − 1). With the exit P/B fixed at 1.45x, the implied BPS compounding is 10.7% (calculated (592.94 × 2.411 ÷ (357.73 × 1.45))^(1/10) − 1).
- Market cap about $1,262 billion (calculated 592.94 × 1,418,900 × 1,500) − net cash $356.9 billion − equities $335.5 billion = value assigned to operating businesses about $569.5 billion → 15.0x annualized after-tax operating earnings excluding investment income of $38.08 billion (calculated 569,523 ÷ 38,080, same approximation as the first round).
- Reference (not reflected): applying the 10-year yield of 5.10% (2026-11-12, data/latest.json meta.macro.ust10) gives a discount rate of 9.35% (calculated 5.10% + 5.0% × 0.85) · base present value about $458 (calculated 772.3 × 1.45 ÷ 1.0935^10). Recalculating the discount rate is for the next monthly round (2026-12).
- The share price's +3.1% over 4 trading days (calculated 592.94 ÷ 575.25 − 1) occurred with no change in disclosed figures — it is not material for this probe's judgment (no adjustments outside the rules, prompts/monthly_run.md item 2).
